section.heading: Our Memberships
section.subtitle: Every requisition, bonded cold-chain transfer, and technical dispatch operates under internationally audited maritime and quality management frameworks—delivering verifiable compliance across every major port and anchorage.

items.name: HACCP
items.standard: Codex Alimentarius — Hazard Analysis & Critical Control Point
items.description: Guarantees strict hazard control across procurement, cold-storage warehousing and reefer launch delivery for all fresh, frozen and dry marine provisions.

items.name: ISO 27001
items.description: Protects fleet procurement data, vessel schedules, electronic invoicing and portal integrations across all global branch offices.

items.name: ISO 14001
items.description: Governs responsible marine waste disposal, chemical handling, packaging reduction and MARPOL-compliant port supply operations.

items.name: IMPA
items.standard: International Marine Purchasing Association — Supplier Member
items.description: Full compliance with the IMPA Marine Stores Guide (MSG) 6-digit coding system for rapid, unambiguous technical and deck store requisitions worldwide.

items.name: ISSA
items.description: Adheres to the ISSA Code of Ethics and Conditions of Sale, ensuring transparent pricing, customs compliance and reliable alongside delivery.

items.name: ISO 22000
items.description: End-to-end food safety traceability from vetted agricultural and bonded suppliers directly to the vessel's galley stores.

items.name: ISO 9001
items.description: Audited quality management covering RFQs, technical item verification, customs clearance and 24/7 dispatch turnaround times.

items.name: Shipserve
items.description: Direct electronic RFQ, quote and PO integration with shipowners and technical managers via the global ShipServ platform.

items.name: Procureship
items.description: Seamless digital requisitioning and automated catalogue matching for fleet purchasing departments worldwide.
